title: Maximum Relative Percentage Error Propagation
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: The area of a rectangle is A = xy. If errors in measuring x and y are at most 1% and 2% respectively, estimate the maximum percentage error in the calculated area.

steps.title: Compute Relative Differential dA/A
steps.mathExpression: dA = y \, dx + x \, dy \implies \frac{dA}{A} = \frac{y \, dx + x \, dy}{xy} = \frac{dx}{x} + \frac{dy}{y}
steps.explanation: Divide total differential dA by area formula A = xy.

steps.title: Sum Maximum Relative Absolute Errors
steps.explanation: Apply triangle inequality to bound worst-case relative error.
